info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Asset Management API
info.description: The Customer Asset Management API provides businesses with the ability to efficiently access detailed information about specific assets associated with their customers. By querying with the unique identifiers for both the customer and the asset, users can retrieve comprehensive data that aids in asset tracking and management. This API is ideal for organizations that need to monitor customer assets, enhance customer service, or analyze asset performance. Typical consumers include support teams, asset managers, and data analysts seeking to optimize asset utilization and customer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific asset associated with a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a specific asset belonging to a particular customer using their unique identifiers. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to access this asset.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving asset information for a specific customer. This request retrieves the details associated with the asset identified by RES-100045 for the customer identified as CUST-100045.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested asset details.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer Authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). When a user successfully logs in, a token is generated and provided. This token should be included in the Authorization header of subsequent requests in the following format: 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
